title.ja: 偽の債券・定期預金（Imposter bond）詐欺

short_desc.ja: 有名銀行の『低リスク債券』を装い偽の比較サイト経由で入金させる
short_desc.en: Fake 'low-risk bonds' lure deposits via fake comparison sites.

cultural_lever.ja: 『安全資産』『豪州国債』という安心感
cultural_lever.en: Perceived safety of bonds and government debt

scenario.ja: 1) 有名銀行名で接触 2) 低リスク『Treasury bonds』を提案 3) 偽の比較サイト経由で情報収集 4) 入金後に消失
scenario.en: 1) Contact in a known bank's name 2) Offer low-risk 'Treasury bonds' 3) Collect data via fake comparison site 4) Vanish after deposit

ja: 既存の有名銀行名を名乗る急な接触
送金先口座名が運用会社名と一致しない
偽の比較サイトから入力した個人情報の確認要求
en: Unexpected contact in a known bank's name
Account name differs from investment firm
Verification requests via a fake comparison site

ja: 送金先口座名が業者名と一致するか確認
ASIC の Investor Alert List で業者照合
BSB コードが提示銀行と一致するか確認
en: Check the destination account matches the firm
Verify on ASIC's Investor Alert List
Check the BSB matches the stated bank

legal_notes.ja: Scamwatch と ASIC へ報告。送金先口座名の照合が重要
legal_notes.en: Report to Scamwatch and ASIC; verify destination account name

references.label: ASIC MoneySmart: Imposter bond investment scams
references.quote: A scammer may contact you with an investment offer, claiming to be from a well-known bank or investment company. The people you speak to can seem knowledgeable, offering what appears to be a 'full service' brokerage. ... Scammers commonly set up fake comparison websites to lure investors. ... Be wary of surprise contact and independently verify who you are dealing with.

verification.note: ASIC MoneySmart が、装う相手（well-known bank or investment company）、経路（fake comparison websites）、推奨対策（independently verify）を明示
